'''Barris Mecandes''' is a [[Cairhien]]in nobleman.

==Appearance==
He is short, and is in his fifties.

==History==
His wife, Lady [[Holleen Mecandes|Holleen]], is the head of the largest [[Darkfriend]] cell in Cairhien.

Their daughter [[Elspeth Mecandes|Elspeth]] goes missing during the time period of Lady [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron|Berelain]] being appointed [[Steward of the Dragon]] in Cairhien.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
